units: <cite ref="Sukkah 52b:6">Succ. 52ᵇ</cite> <he>אבר … מַרְעִיבוֹ שבע משביעו ר׳</he> a small organ is in man, when you starve it, it is satisfied, when you satisfy it, it is hungry; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 107a:4">Snh. 107ᵃ</cite>. Mekh. B’shall., s. 4 <he>ר׳ האכילו</he> when the child was hungry, he gave him food; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 233:5">Yalk. Ex. 233</cite> <cite ref="T00871"><he>נִרְעָב</he></cite>); a. e.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="T00870">same</cite>. Mekh. l. c. <he>ה׳ האכילו</he> when Israel was hungry, he (the Lord) gave him food.
to starve, subject to privation. Succ. l. c.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 65b:14">Snh. 65ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 18:11">Deut. XVIII, 11</cite> <he>דורש אל המתים</he>) <he>זה המַרְעִיב עצמו וכ׳</he> that is he who fasts and spends the night in the cemetery in order that the spirit of impurity (unholy inspiration) may rest upon him. Ib. 100ᵃ <he>כל המרעיב עצמו וכ׳</he> him who undergoes privations for the sake of studying the words of the Law in this world, the Lord will satisfy &c. Y. Keth. V, 30ᵇ <he>האבר הזה הִרְעִיבָתוֹ השביעתו … הרעיבתו</he> that certain organ, if she starves it, she makes it satisfied, the more she satisfies it, the more she makes it hungry, v. supra.
